recorder.open_close: FI_OPEN installs the lane/wave/CTA recorder predicate; FI_CLOSE is required on every executed exit path.
fits: ABI tag fields must match the selected recorder. Do not invent a new event layout in the recipe.
notes: Use one logical begin/end pair per selected semantic interval.

Pillar I-IV (v14 <= 10% perturbation engine): CuTeDSL recorder (2_instrument/recorders/cutedsl/fi_cute.py) supports dual-anchor affine local clock calibration (readcyclecounter + globaltimer anchors), single-exit helpers with cute.arch.barrier() brackets around cute.gemm, L2-isolated host fi_reset, and closed-loop stride selection S in {full(1), stride4(4), stride8(8)} enforcing Measured_Overhead(S*) <= 10.0% (fi_trace_gate.py G1-G5).
Keep aux stable between pair members so waits and phases can be correlated.
The device recorder can only carry a 32-bit aux; move larger descriptors to names.json or the capture metadata.

source_recognition_policy.resolution: Assign a semantic ID only after reading the enclosing dataflow and the operator/task boundary.

correctness_hazards: SASS/ISA disturbance: instrumentation and surrounding code motion can change instruction count, register allocation, spills, vector width, and the selected tensor-core or copy family. Compile FI_LEVEL=0/1/2 and compare the final SASS.
Divergence/mask: a recorder in a divergent branch can produce unpaired records or deadlock a barrier. Preserve the original predicate and use the target wave size for lane selection.
Buffer overflow: fixed slots can fill or point out of range. Require the device overflow bits to be zero, records per lane to stay below cap, and no ring/wrap behavior.

Asynchronous completion: cp.async, TMA, tcgen05, and collectives have issue and completion boundaries that are not interchangeable. wgmma remains unverified for B300 and must not be inferred from H20.
Correctness drift: moving code across predicates, fences, or waits can change numerical results or visibility even when the kernel still runs.
validation_requirements: Parse all JSON and validate this document against knowledge/validation/schemas/recipe.schema.json.
Use only semantic IDs present in knowledge/semantic_ids.json; display names must exactly equal their IDs.
Compile off, entry-only, and full builds with Python 3.10 orchestration where applicable; compare final SASS and register/spill metrics.
Run full-output correctness against an uninstrumented reference with tail, mask, dtype, and shape cases for the selected operator.
Verify cap, slot count, records per lane, overflow bits, and trace completeness.
Capture the selected hardware evidence with the card profiler and keep B300 sm_100a/sm_103a evidence separate.

semantics.description: Global-to-register/shared data movement, including asynchronous copy issue or completion boundaries.

placement.begin: Immediately before the selected load issue or first synchronous load instruction for the tile.
placement.end: For synchronous loads, after the loaded value is available. For cp.async/TMA, after the matching wait makes data visible to consumers, not at issue.
placement.async_completion_caveat: A cp.async/TMA issue timestamp is not a completion timestamp. Use FI_M at issue when issue latency matters and pair FI_B/FI_E with the consumer-side wait.
placement.scope: phase inside the enclosing operator; default one span per tile or work item
